_comment: JSON-Schema-SUBSET for build_icp_review_emit.py's icp-review-emit.json (BC-12943, ADR-028 Phase-2 Batch B). Validated by scripts/eval/assert_lib.py — supported keywords ONLY: type (name or list; 'null' matches None), required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, enum, const. Asserts the matrix SHAPE. counts/mutated_statuses/emit_verticals are left type-only so the golden + golden_compare lock per-branch values: an OK row carries the apply count summary + per-signal promotion_status flips + lint_exit_code 0 (the structure-first anchor: the mutated discoveries.json still lints) + the emit-handbook promoted-blob set; a rejection row (a decision-map guard, exit 1 data-error or exit 2 usage-error) carries nulls for the apply-side fields + a non-null error (scan_total_pending still ran).
